purpose: Register a fresh paired screen for the channel-preserving patch-token branch after correcting the hard-selected relation configuration.
research_question: Across four local multivariate datasets, does adding MambaACF patch tokens to the same AutoCon/ACF relation contract improve validation forecasting without an unacceptable resource increase?
evidence_boundary: Unauthorized exploratory validation-only screen. This matrix is separate from the uncorrected all-candidate pilot, historical fair screens, and the plain-baseline expansion.
claim_boundary: Report paired dataset-horizon-seed deltas, relation coverage, parameter counts, training wall time, and resource measurements. Do not claim universal accuracy, effective AutoCon causality, non-inferiority, or speed before a fresh confirmation matrix.

required_before_launch: human review of the patch-token implementation and 24-job budget
verify all four dataset fingerprints and the active mamba environment
run matched prediction-only and train-step resource smoke for both patch arms
freeze this JSON, create an approved launch sidecar, and use a fresh output root
confirm that test metrics are withheld until the candidate and analysis rules are frozen

seed_policy.reporting_unit: dataset, horizon, model, arm, and seed
seed_policy.artifact_policy: Use only the fresh output root. Retain source snapshot, environment record, dataset hashes, plan hash, per-job config hashes, manifest, validation trajectory, relation telemetry, and phase validation. Never copy historical metrics into this matrix.

phases.name: patch_token_off_h96
phases.purpose: MambaACFAutoCon control with effective hard-selected relation learning and no patch-token residual.

phases.name: patch_token_on_h96
phases.purpose: Same MambaACFAutoCon and relation contract with the channel-preserving time-major patch-token residual enabled.

comparison_contract.interpretation: Use paired seed deltas within each dataset at H96. Windows and channels are not independent replicates. The off/on contrast estimates a structural patch-token difference conditional on the fixed relation contract; it does not isolate AutoCon versus no-AutoCon.
comparison_contract.historical_comparison_rule: Do not append these rows to corrected, fair-screen, high-dimensional, or uncorrected patch pilot tables. A publication matrix must rerun all intended baselines under one frozen source, data, normalization, optimizer, and test-release contract.
comparison_contract.relation_telemetry_boundary: A finite relation loss is insufficient. Report lag exposure, candidate count, contrastive-active anchor fraction, degenerate-positive fraction, and sign accuracy for every arm. If contrastive-active support collapses, the AutoCon interpretation is invalid even if validation loss improves.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: This validation-only screen can decide whether patch tokens merit a larger confirmation experiment; it cannot establish a final ranking, non-inferiority, universal accuracy, or speed claim.

resource_contract.prediction_only: Same GPU, PyTorch/mamba_ssm versions, batch=8, fixed warmup and synchronized p50/p95 latency; report active/total parameters and peak allocated/reserved memory.
resource_contract.train_step: Before launch, measure forward+backward+optimizer with identical FP32/AMP, effective batch, loader workers, and synchronization for both arms on ETTh1 and Traffic shapes; synthetic forward alone is insufficient for a speed claim.
resource_contract.capacity_note: The only allowed architectural difference is the patch-token branch. Keep d_model, Mamba state, variable-token branch, normalization, optimizer, lag sampler, and AutoCon lambda identical. Compare against the separate six-model plain baseline expansion for external context, not as a pooled estimand.

stopping_rules: Do not launch while execution.authorized is false; validate-only and dry-run are the only permitted actions.
If any dataset hash, source snapshot, config hash, sidecar, or phase artifact is missing or changed, stop rather than impute or copy a row.
Do not use test metrics to choose a patch setting, relation target, horizon, or follow-up model.
If contrastive-active anchors remain below 50% or degenerate positives exceed 25% in a cell, retain the telemetry as a failed relation contract and do not claim representation-learning benefit.
If patch-on increases paired validation loss in at least three of four datasets or materially violates the predeclared resource budget, stop patch expansion and retain the negative result.
A favorable validation pattern is descriptive and must be replicated with fresh seeds and a separately reviewed confirmation plan.
